ei.title: Chapter 5-15: Carbohydrates: The Body's Primary Fuel
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Carbohydrates are the most important source of energy in a balanced daily diet. Carbohydrate intake must be balanced with adequate amounts of protein, fat, and water intake. In athletes, carbohydrates are the primary fuel source to maintain blood glucose for energy during exercise. Adequate carbohydrate intake also helps spare muscle from catabolic activity and muscle breakdown. After carbohydrates are consumed, they are broken down into smaller sugars that get absorbed and used as energy. The body is capable of storing excess carbohydrates in the form of glycogen in the muscles and liver. The body's glycogen capacity is approximately 300 to 400 grams. Subsequent excesses are then converted to fat and stored. Conversely, in the setting of inadequate intake, an energy imbalance can result in adverse effects on athletic performance as well as overall health.

det.analysis: 문장6 'storing excess carbohydrates in the form of glycogen in the muscles and liver' → 저장 형태·장소는 glycogen in the muscles and liver(근육과 간에 글리코겐으로). 6단어.
det.tip: glycogen in the muscles and liver = 근육과 간에 글리코겐으로

questions.wa: glycogen in the muscles and liver
accept: glycogen in the muscles and liver

questions.passage: Carbohydrates are the most important source of energy in a balanced daily diet. Carbohydrate intake must be __________ (balance) with adequate amounts of protein, fat, and water intake. In athletes, carbohydrates are the primary fuel source to maintain blood glucose for energy during exercise.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 탄수화물 섭취는 단백질·지방·수분과 '균형이 맞추어져야' 한다.
det.analysis: balance → balanced. 'must be ~'의 수동태이므로 과거분사 balanced가 필요. intake must be balanced with ~ = 섭취는 ~과 균형이 맞추어져야 한다.
det.tip: 조동사 + be + 과거분사: must be balanced

questions.passage: Carbohydrates are the most important source of energy in a balanced daily diet. Carbohydrate intake must be balanced with adequate amounts of protein, fat, and water intake. In athletes, carbohydrates are the primary fuel source to maintain blood glucose for energy during exercise. Adequate carbohydrate intake also helps spare muscle from catabolic activity and muscle breakdown. After carbohydrates are consumed, they are broken down into smaller sugars that get absorbed and used as energy. The body is capable of storing excess carbohydrates in the form of glycogen in the muscles and liver. The body's glycogen capacity is approximately 300 to 400 grams. Subsequent excesses are then converted to fat and stored. Conversely, in the setting of inadequate intake, an energy imbalance can result in adverse effects on athletic performance as well as overall health.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체가 탄수화물의 에너지원·연료로서의 중요성을 설명.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 수분 섭취량 — 글의 초점 아님

❌ ② 단백질과 근육 성장 — 무관

❌ ③ 체지방 감량 식이요법 — 무관

✅ ④ 에너지원·주요 연료로서 탄수화물의 중요성 — 글 전체 주제 ←정답
det.tip: 주제 = 에너지원·운동 연료로서 탄수화물의 중요성

ch: 에너지원이자 운동선수의 주요 연료로서 탄수화물의 중요성

After carbohydrates are consumed, they are broken down into smaller sugars that get absorbed and used as energy. The body is capable of storing excess carbohydrates in the form of glycogen in the muscles and liver. The body's glycogen capacity is approximately 300 to 400 grams. Subsequent excesses are then converted to fat and stored. Conversely, in the setting of inadequate intake, an energy imbalance can result in adverse effects on athletic performance as well as overall health.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 핵심: 탄수화물은 핵심 에너지원이며 적절한 섭취가 중요하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 적게 섭취 — 반대

❌ ② 지방에 의존 — 반대. 탄수화물이 주요 연료

✅ ③ 핵심 에너지원·적절한 섭취 중요 — 글의 핵심 ←정답

❌ ④ 글리코겐 해로움 — 반대. 글리코겐은 예비 에너지원
det.tip: 요지 = 탄수화물은 핵심 에너지원, 적절한 섭취가 중요

ch: 탄수화물은 가능한 한 적게 섭취하는 것이 좋다.
탄수화물은 몸과 운동선수에게 핵심 에너지원이며 적절한 섭취가 중요하다.
글리코겐은 몸에 해로우므로 반드시 피해야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)
'에너지 불균형은 운동 능력에 부정적인 영향을 초래할 수 있다'
[조건] (1) adverse, an, athletic, can, effects, energy, imbalance, in, on, performance, result를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 에너지 불균형은 운동 능력에 부정적인 영향을 초래할 수 있다
det.analysis: an(1) energy(2) imbalance(3) can(4) result(5) in(6) adverse(7) effects(8) on(9) athletic(10) performance(11) = 11단어. 주어 an energy imbalance + can result in(~을 초래하다) + adverse effects on athletic performance.
det.tip: result in adverse effects on ~ = ~에 부정적 영향을 초래하다

questions.wa: an energy imbalance can result in adverse effects on athletic performance
accept: an energy imbalance can result in adverse effects on athletic performance
